decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through a product feed heavily cluttered with accessories like replacement batteries, cables, and cases. For actual speakers, I narrowed my search to products with high ratings and substantial review counts. The Sony SRS-XB43 was the most compelling option; while it is at a higher price point ($156.34), its 4.7 rating across over 5,000 reviews and reputable brand name make it a more reliable investment than the budget alternatives. I also considered the INSMY and NOTABRICK for their high value-to-price ratios, but ultimately decided on the Sony for its superior sound and build quality.
